author: KEXP
description:
Ukrainian vocal group YAGODY combine performance, hypnotic harmonies, and primal percussion to keep the spirit of Eastern European folk tradition alive. With host Darek Mazzone, they share a performance of "BramaYA" and more. 

Find the full in-studio session on our channel and support worldwide music discovery when you make a donation to our Spring Drive.
title: YAGODY perform BramaYA Live on KEXP
